question: The owner's question this feeds.
hypothesis: Treatment X raises metric M by at least D against control C.
prior_expectation: What I expect, including where I expect to be wrong.
unit: player | round | run (the unit the interval is over)

measure.data: held-out set or seed range, named

yardstick.pre_test: what must reproduce before any real data

decision_table.win: interval lower bound above the line -> next step
decision_table.loss: interval upper bound below the line -> next step
decision_table.null: inside the equivalence band at max sample -> say so and stop
decision_table.unclear: extend once to max; still unclear is reported as unclear
decision_table.borderline: on the threshold -> value with error, no line move, confirm on fresh disjoint data, then decide by this table

void_rules: taken from the system's own log, independent of who was ahead
